scope: All 36 design section 6 mutations are applicable. Each patch independently targets git archive REF_COMMIT, never HEAD or the working tree. Historical catches and current area-4 evidence are reported separately; this manifest does not claim a completed 36/36 campaign.

mutations.description: Choose maximum probability instead of cheapest sufficient cumulative route
